title: Run-length encode a string
prompt:
Write runLengthEncode(String s) returning the run-length encoding of s: walk the
string left to right and replace each maximal run of one repeated character with that
character followed by the length of the run. A run of length 1 still gets its count.
The encoding is case sensitive, and the empty string encodes to the empty string.

Examples:
  runLengthEncode("aaabb")  -> "a3b2"
  runLengthEncode("abc")    -> "a1b1c1"
  runLengthEncode("aabbaa") -> "a2b2a2"   // the two a-runs stay separate
  runLengthEncode("")       -> ""

Keep the class name Solution and the given method signature.
